Immerse yourself into the wonder and delight
Vinpearl Wonderworld Phu Quoc features exclusively villas that focus on the privacy of all guests, and intimate touch with nature, from lush gardens to private, expansive beaches. The resort is also within a close vicinity with an international-standard golf course in the midst of an old-growth forest, which brings a unique experience to any visitor.
Room types
Two Bedroom Villa
Two Bedroom Villa from 261m² with private garden is generously sized and thoughtfully equipped. Our Villa 2 Bedrooms is ideal for guests of different interests; from honeymooners, as a romantic hideaway to classy groups or business travellers with a good taste and appreciation of luxurious design.
Three Bedroom Villa
The 279 sqm Villa 3 Bedrooms is generously sized and thoughtfully equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay. With an exquisite view of the lake, our Villa 3 Bedrooms is perfect for families and groups in need of ultimate relaxation.
Deluxe Family Villa 3-Bedroom Safari
Custom-designed to ignite the imagination of young explorers our 279sqm, 3 bedroom villa brings the outdoors indoors and comes complete with its own tepee, tropical landscape, some furry friend plush toys as well as child friendly amenities. With the addition of stunning lake views, a private pool for your family to enjoy and a small garden oasis, this villa is a perfect fit for a fun family vacation.
Ocean Haven Villa 3-Bedroom
The 3-bedroom villa, from 279 m², features a modern design, private pool, and stunning sea and garden views. Enjoy sunrise or sunset moments, private BBQs, in-villa movie nights, or your own morning coffee. An ideal choice for families and friends seeking a luxurious and relaxing getaway.
Four Bedroom Villa
The 405m² Four Bedroom Villa is generously sized and thoughtfully equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay. With an exquisite view of the lake or garden, our Villa 4 Bedrooms is perfect for families and groups in need of ultimate relaxation.
Deluxe Family Villa 4-Bedroom Nautilus
Create a splash with our new Nautilus Family themed villas that invite your little ones to step on board in ship shape fashion and sail away to dreamland. With 405sqm, 4 bedrooms, a private pool, child friendly amenities and reflective lake views, our oceanic themed family villas brings life on the seas alive, and are large enough to accommodate multi-generational families for an affordable yet luxurious family experience
Ocean Haven Villa 4-Bedroom
The 4-bedroom villa spans 360 m² across two luxurious floors, offering ultimate privacy and comfort. Enjoy sunrise and sunset views, private BBQs, in-villa movie nights, or your own morning coffee. A perfect choice for families and friends seeking a premium retreat for leisure or business.
Ocean Haven Villa 2-Bedroom
The 2-bedroom villa, spanning from 190 m², with private pool and top-notch amenities. Enjoy sunrise or sunset moments, private BBQs, in-villa movie nights, or your own morning coffee. An ideal choice for families and friends seeking a luxurious and relaxing getaway.

The quintessence of international cuisine
Your culinary journey will become perfect with Vinpearl Wonderworld Phu Quoc as a destination. It brings together the quintessential dishes of all regions in Vietnam and the world, all personally prepared by five-star chefs exclusively for you.
The Haven Beach Club
